subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: How should existing WhatsApp accounts transition when the canonical Baileys browser identity changes to Desktop?
rationale: The runtime correction is well supported, but existing credentials may enter a 428 setup loop until re-paired, so the upgrade behavior requires an explicit maintainer choice.

options.title: Guided re-pair
options.body: Detect legacy identity-bound credentials, stop with an actionable explanation, and guide the operator through logout and QR re-pairing.

options.title: Automatic invalidation
options.body: Have doctor or the upgrade path clear legacy credentials and require a new QR pairing on the next start.

options.title: Opt-in transition
options.body: Preserve the current default and add a Desktop identity option that operators enable before manually re-pairing.

recommendation.title: Guided re-pair
recommendation.body: Detect legacy identity-bound credentials, stop with an actionable explanation, and guide the operator through logout and QR re-pairing.
